title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine
description: BDR v1.0.0 is the first stable-engine line of the Resolutive Database Engine. It provides a frozen public C++ source API, the bdr::bdr CMake consumer target, CompactIndex as the preferred internal index, BDR3 snapshots, BDW3 write-ahead logs, streaming checkpoints, crash recovery, and reproducible high-cardinality validation. Performance claims remain workload-specific and the project does not claim strict worst-case O(1) complexity for the complete engine. The associated scientific preprint is a separate Zenodo publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21937842.
